operations.before: // If `in` was found and this specific external keyword is valid,

operations.after:
optional(seq($.type, '.')),
      alias($._parameters_with_optional_type, $.function_value_parameters),
      optional(seq(':', $.type)),
      optional($.type_constraints),
      optional($.function_body),
    )),

    _parameters_with_optional_type: $ => seq(
      '(',
      optionalCommaSep1(seq(
        optional($.parameter_modifiers),
        alias(seq($._identifier, optional(seq(':', $.type))), $.parameter),
        optional(seq('=', $.expression)),
      )),
      ')',
    ),

operations.before:
when_entry: $ => seq(
      choice(
        seq(
          commaSep1(field('condition', $._when_condition)),
          optional(','),
        ),
        'else',
      ),
operations.after:
when_entry: $ => seq(
      choice(
        seq(
          commaSep1(field('condition', $._when_condition)),
          optional(','),
        ),
        seq(field('condition', $._when_condition), 'if', field('guard', $.expression)),
        'else',
        seq('else', 'if', field('guard', $.expression)),
      ),

context_parameters: $ => seq(
      'context',
      '(',
      commaSep1(choice($.parameter, $.type)),
      optional(','),
      ')',
    ),

    function_type: $ => seq(
      optional($.context_parameters),
      optional($.type_modifiers),

// used to check if an explicit backing field may follow
    'field',
    $._md_string_start,
    $._md_multiline_string_start,
    $._md_string_content,
    $._md_interpolation_dollars,
    $._md_string_end,
  ],
